title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary: Fixed empty Semio Table TOC body rows: `semio_window_register_body_materialize` used `\exp_args:Ne`, which fully expanded `\semio@register@data` / `\SemioTableRegisterRow` during materialize (outside tabular), so only the Nr/Titel/Seite header rendered. Switched to `\exp_args:No` so row tokens are stored and expanded inside `\SemioTableRegister` when `.sctoc` is loaded on pass 2. Also added `\renewcommand{\semio@window@header@invoke}` after `\semio@window@header@muted` to fix expl3 forward-reference tokenization for window chrome.
